name: Nolan P. Sloan
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Boston, Massachusetts
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, Medical Malpractice, Employment & Labor
about: Nolan P. Sloan is a dedicated attorney assisting clients in matters of personal injury from his office at Peck Trial Attorneys, PC, in Boston, Massachusetts. Handling matters involving serious injuries, construction accidents, medical malpractice, premises liability, product liability, wrongful death and wrongful termination, he serves individuals in the Greater Boston metro area. With nearly a decade of experience, he has successfully secured millions in compensation for his clients.

After completing his undergraduate degree in legal studies in 2014 from the University of Buffalo, Mr. Sloan pursued his law degree at Suffolk University Law School. He was a certified paralegal in college and gained his Juris Doctor in 2017. In the following year, he was admitted to practice law in Massachusetts. Throughout his undergraduate and law degree, he held multiple positions as a legal intern and clerked at a law firm, serving as primary law clerk and assisting attorneys in personal injury cases.

Prior to joining his current firm, Mr. Sloan gained extensive experience working in Social Security Disability and personal injury law firms. Today, he completely focuses his practice on helping individuals who have been injured due to someone else’s negligence. Committed to providing personalized legal representation, he ensures that each client receives the attention and care they deserve while navigating the complexities of their cases effectively.

Mr. Sloan’s approach to cases is deeply rooted in the values drilled into him during his early years in his career. This background has shaped his view of justice and allows him to be more empathetic with clients in difficult situations. As a personal injury lawyer, he is driven by a strong commitment to advocate for the rights and welfare of those he represents, ensuring they receive the support and compensation they deserve in their time of need.
